en.description:
Strap in, twist the throttle, and race full-speed on your wrist.

This is high-speed arcade motorcycle action built exclusively for Apple Watch. Lean into corners, weave through traffic, and push your bike using the watch crown controller to its limits as you blast through multiple themed stages inspired by classic 80s arcade racing.

But you’re not alone on the road, enemy riders crowd the track and will slow you down if you bump into them. Stay sharp, overtake everything, and hit those checkpoints before time runs out.

FEATURES

• Classic arcade racing, rebuilt for Apple Watch
• Multiple levels with unique layouts, palettes, and difficulty
• Enemy motorbikes that block, bump, and slow you down
• Tilt to steer for intuitive, responsive control
• Checkpoint-based progression—keep the speed up or it’s game over
• Fast, fluid gameplay optimized for the watch display
• Retro-inspired visuals and sound capturing that authentic 80s racing feel

Master every stage, learn the curves, and pass every rival on the road.
The finish line is waiting. Can you reach it in time?

Speed. Style. Pure arcade adrenaline right on your wrist.
en.subtitle: Moto race full-speed
